create_multibody_snake: create a multi-body snake robot with 36 revolute joints using pybullet createMultiBody
create_collision_shape: create a box collision shape with specified half extents using pybullet createCollisionShape
set_joint_motor_control: set joint motor control with position control and target position using setJointMotorControl2
change_dynamics_friction: change body dynamics to set lateral friction and anisotropic friction using changeDynamics
run_snake_simulation: run a pybullet snake simulation with keyboard steering and sinusoidal wave locomotion
